title: Switch Stacking
description: Understand how switch stacking creates a single logical switch.
scenario: Understand how switch stacking creates a single logical switch.

concepts.title: Switch Stacking
concepts.body: Stacking connects multiple switches with stack cables to act as one logical switch with a single management IP.
concepts.code: SW1 + SW2 + SW3 → one logical switch

concepts.title: Stack Members
concepts.body: Each switch has a member number (1-9). The master manages the stack. Members are numbered by priority.
concepts.code:
SW1# show switch
Switch/Port  Role     Mac Address
1           Master   00:1B:2F:3C:4D:5E
2           Member   00:1B:2F:3C:4D:5F

concepts.title: Benefits
concepts.body: Single management point, shared config, high availability, and more ports.
concepts.code:
One IP to manage all
Shared configuration
Redundant master
